steps.title: Write three directions
Approve the directions
steps.gate_summary: Read {{run.dir}}/direction-0.md to direction-2.md. Approve to build all three, reject to stop.

steps.title: Build each direction
steps.prompt:
Build the page described in {{run.dir}}/direction-{{index}}.md in this worktree, for this brief: {{inputs.brief}}

Make `npm run dev -- --port <n>` serve it on port n. Stop any server you start before you finish; the workbench serves it and opens the preview once you are done. Commit your work on the current branch. Do not push.

steps.title: Pick a variant
steps.gate_summary: Pick one tile in the variants grid (or Combine two), then Continue.

steps.title: Polish the picked variant
steps.prompt:
This worktree holds the picked design for: {{inputs.brief}}

Polish it: fix spacing, contrast and alignment, make it work at 390 px wide, and keep the direction. Commit on the current branch ({{variants.picked.branch}}). Do not push.
